text:
Maria (Finance): Quick question on BlueCrest Labs' renewal invoice INV-2158 — looks like the platform fee was charged twice for overlapping periods. Can someone confirm effective date for the support tier change?

Ryan (AE): We shipped the signed amendment on Apr 15; upgrade to Platinum effective Apr 15 per the amendment. Customer signed in DocuSign (link in SF).

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2158 generated 2026-04-18 09:02 UTC. Line items: `platform fee (Apr 1-30) $5,000`, `platform fee proration (Apr 15-30) $2,500`, `support tier (Gold->Platinum) adj $12,000`.

Aman (BillingEng): Hmm — two platform fee lines could be correct (full month + prorate) if system didn't zero the original when proration applied. Can you paste the invoice export or the invoice_id? I'll pull the entitlement events.

Maria (Finance): Paste of the invoice export: ```
invoice_id,description,period_start,period_end,amount
INV-2158,Platform Fee,2026-04-01,2026-04-30,5000
INV-2158,Platform Fee Proration,2026-04-15,2026-04-30,2500
INV-2158,Support Tier Upgrade (Gold->Platinum),2026-04-15,2027-04-14,12000
```

Aman (BillingEng): Thanks. Running quick query against entitlement events: `SELECT event_time, event_type, note FROM entitlement_events WHERE acct='bluecrest' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30';` Output snippet: ```
2026-04-15T13:22Z,PLAN_CHANGE,upgrade request id=chg-9987
2026-04-15T13:23Z,PROCESSING,prorate applied pr-id=pr-431
``` Looks like proration applied but original month line wasn't reconciled away. Will open a billing fix.

Lisa (FinanceMgr): If the system left the full-month platform fee in addition to proration, we should issue a credit for the duplicate $2,500. Need sign-off from finance lead to post CM-789 for $2,500. Approve? @Lisa (FinanceMgr) — copying because I will need GL code.

Sam (CS): Confirmed amendment effective Apr 15, BlueCrest expects a pro-rata credit; they flagged the invoice yesterday. They prefer a credit memo rather than refund.

Ryan (AE): Customer message: "credit is fine, please reflect on next billing cycle." :thumbsup: 

Lisa (FinanceMgr): Approved. Create credit memo CM-789 for $2,500, GL account 4102-PlatformCredits. Please include note "Duplicate platform fee proration — system reconciliation."

Aman (BillingEng): I'll run the correction and attach reconciliation notes. Plan: 1) post CM-789 2) update invoice metadata to mark as adjusted 3) create a short postmortem entry for the proration path. ETA 24h.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-789 created and linked to INV-2158 (created_by=Aman). Ticket BILL-4032 opened for postmortem.

Maria (Finance): Thanks all. Assigning follow-ups: Aman to fix and close BILL-4032; Lisa to approve GL posting; Ryan to confirm with customer once CM posts. Closing here unless anything else.

Aman (BillingEng): I'll add the reconciliation CSV to the ticket and ping when done.

Lisa (FinanceMgr): Noted, will post GL when I see CM-789 in AR queue.

Ryan (AE): I'll message BlueCrest after CM posts.

Maria (Finance): closing thread.
